packageRules.description: The example app's runtime versions are dictated by the installed Expo SDK, and expo-doctor fails the build when they drift. The shared preset names the usual suspects; this widens it to everything the example app declares. Refresh the lockfile inside the declared ranges, never widen them. SDK jumps are done by hand.

@expo/metro-runtime rides the Expo SDK and is held at the SDK version by a pnpm-workspace.yaml override, which the file rule above doesn't reach. The shared preset covers metro and friends but its expo-* pattern doesn't match the scoped name.

Stricter than the shared preset, which only holds react-native to in-range. packages/modal builds and tests against the same react-native the example app runs, which the Expo SDK dictates. Bumping it on its own installs a second copy and expo-doctor fails on the duplicate. Moves by hand with the SDK.
